## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Is your feature request related to a problem?
Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## 🎯 Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🔄 User Stories
Describe how users would interact with this feature:
- As a [user type], I want [functionality] so that [benefit]
- As a [user type], I want [functionality] so that [benefit]

## 🎨 UI/UX Mockups
If applicable, add sketches, wireframes, or mockups of the proposed feature.

## 📱 Platform Priority
Which platforms should this feature target first?
- [ ] Android
- [ ] iOS (future)
- [ ] Web (future)
- [ ] All platforms

## 🏆 Success Criteria
How will we know this feature is successful?
- [ ] User engagement increases
- [ ] Specific metrics improve
- [ ] User feedback is positive
- [ ] Other (please specify)

## 🔧 Technical Considerations
Any technical constraints or requirements:
- [ ] Requires backend changes
- [ ] Needs third-party integration
- [ ] Requires special permissions
- [ ] Performance considerations
- [ ] Storage requirements

## 🎯 Priority Level
How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical (app unusable without it)
- [ ] High (significantly improves experience)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (minor improvement)

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Describe alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📊 Similar Apps
Are there apps that have this feature? How do they implement it?

## 📚 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## 🛠️ Implementation Ideas
If you have ideas about how this could be implemented, please share:
- Suggested approach
- Potential challenges
- Resources needed

**Note**: Please check if a similar feature request already exists before creating a new one.
